notes:
Seabyss II — Beta 0.1.7-beta.46

- Increased ship repair from 250 to 500 HP per second while preserving the existing safety checks.
- Enabled pass-through between player and NPC ships, between NPC ships, and between player ships; islands and world geometry remain blocking.
- Improved player navigation with direct-path priority, shortest complete paths, corner simplification, partial-path rejection, and bounded direct-path rechecks around islands.
- Planned server restarts now close Beta.46 clients completely while ordinary disconnects retain their existing behavior.
- Improved Equip and Unequip button visibility with the validated brown, gold, and ivory authored visuals.
- Fixed Quest Processing with durable terminal acknowledgements, bounded reconciliation, and exactly-once reward protection.
- Added signed, owner-only chunked Quest profile transfer for large profiles and reconnects.
- Compacted Cauldron persistence while preserving immutable plans, provider fencing, crash recovery, receipts, and exactly-once rewards.
- Purchases remain disabled for this Beta release.
